ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture section. All students must enroll in this lecture section (AL1) and a lab section (AB1 or AB2) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and undergraduates (juniors or seniors) must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). See http://courseweb.lis.uiuc.edu/~mwolske/lis451/fall09/ for further details about this course including details about the lab sections. A non-waived $70 course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition & fees bill. 4 hours undergraduate and graduate credit.
